members.description: Root/Addon are div role=group. Addon align defaults inline-start and accepts inline-end/block-start/block-end. Its default onClick focuses the first descendant input in its parent, except when target.closest(button) exists. It does not target textarea. Because {...props} is spread after onClick, a caller onClick replaces this default handler. Input/Textarea delegate actual Input/Textarea. InputGroupButton defaults type=button, variant=ghost, size=xs; sizes xs/sm/icon-xs/icon-sm. InputGroupText is span, not an automatic label or describedby relation.
